items.title: The Agentic Scientist: Paper talk now on YouTube!

post.text:
The Agentic Scientist: Paper talk now on YouTube!

In this talk, we argue that The Agentic Scientist creates a framework by which off-the-shelf coding agents can be used as research collaborators.

Solely relying on off-the-shelf coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex, these agents tend to behave like strong hyperparameter optimizers when given a research question. While the scores improve, the ideas remain narrow and the reasons for gains are rarely examined.

post.text:
Ven was one of the earliest believers that we could use our then-current model to solve millenium prize problems.

There are a lot of brilliant people in the world, but being brilliant and also having correctly-placed confidence and courage to keep pushing on something that others don't think is possible is a very valuable thing and fairly rare.

I am grateful so many people at OpenAI have this combination.
